request:
덕테이프 포스터로 성인 대상 동네 인쇄·낭독 행사를 안내해줘. 처음 오는 주민에게도 친근하되 성인 문화 행사에 어울리게 해줘. 생활문화센터와 커뮤니티의 디지털 화면에 쓰는 16:9 가로형으로, 서로 다른 스타일 다섯 장을 만들어줘. 스타일은 맡길게. 고무판으로 종이에 찍는 작업과 그 인쇄물을 함께 읽는 행사가 연결되어 보이고, 일정·장소·입장·참가 조건·준비 안내가 읽혀야 해. 아래 문구만 각각 한 번씩 넣어줘.

인쇄하고 읽는 밤
PRINT & READ
고무판 인쇄 · 짧은 낭독
2026.12.12 토요일
18:00–20:30
망원 생활문화센터
17:40부터 입장
참가비 5,000원 · 재료 포함
신청 후 참여 · 정원 24명
앞치마 지참
처음 해도 괜찮아요
common_constraints: Print every supplied entry exactly once, with readable Korean/English and intact punctuation; no added text, logos, pseudo-print, watermark or QR.
Each result is one separate flat opaque landscape16:9 poster, not a stretched/cropped portrait or a contact sheet.
Five genuinely distinct complete visual systems, composition, image/type roles and impressions, beyond material/filter/palette changes.
Substantive content-grounded nonglyph visual construction required; type/whitespace-only, tiny icon/texture and glyph-model-only loopholes prohibited.

Rubber-block printing onto paper and shared reading of that printed work must be visibly connected, with an approachable adult cultural-event tone. All supplied practical information must be readable at usage720.

planning_scale: 720 × 405 planning/use canvas, not native resolution. Rectangles [x,y,w,h]; sizes are visible px. Wrap only at supplied word boundaries.

directions.reference_transfer: Feixen: continuous movement links type, image and ground; rebuild it as a functional sheet/impression, without ribbons, grid or cropped letters. Mut: one event hierarchy binds making and reading; people replace the bloom.

Fingers grip the clean slab edge; rubber thickness, contact gap and transferred mark are separate. Two readers support the same sheet with visible gaze/mouths.

directions.emotion: Energetic adult neighbourhood culture, made approachable by attentive faces and the readable welcome.
